dailyHeadline: UNDEFEATED CAAAAM FACES WITNESS-PROTECTION CARLACOTE AS SHIPOOPIEHOLE STUNS TYLERO0 BY 0.42 POINTS
dailySubhead: Fresh off a 167.26-point explosion and a highway-robbery trade for Nico Collins, 6-4 CarlaCote steps up to test 10-0 Caaaam in Week 11 while 0-FAAB CerealStroke finally tastes victory.
tickerTape: WEEK 10 HEARTBREAKER: 2-8 Shipoopiehole upsets 7-3 Tylero0 by 0.42 points (152.56 - 152.14) to snap Tylero0's momentum
THE KINGSTON JUGGERNAUT: Caaaam moves to 10-0 after smoking Unanswered 158.32 - 123.66, now 1-0 against every mortal soul
TRADE DESK SHOCKER: CarlaCote lands Nico Collins & Blake Corum from PrayingGrantis for just Matthew Golden
WAIVER WIRE BLITZ: JewsInParis drops $8 FAAB on Buffalo Bills DEF while Tylero0 drops $12 total on Mark Andrews, Kaelon Black & Steelers DEF
CEREALSTROKE LIVES: 1-9 CerealStroke drops 164.18 points to crush 7-straight-loser owenriddell (86.52) with $0 FAAB spent all year
ELORD11 ON LIFE SUPPORT: Despite trading for Drake London, Garrett Wilson & A.J. Brown, ELord11 sits at 3-7 on a brutal 5-game skid

roasts.headline: CarlaCote Emerges From Witness Protection to Rob PrayingGrantis Blind for Nico Collins
roasts.body:
Stop the Kingston campus buses and alert the URI campus police—CarlaCote just remembered their Sleeper password and immediately committed grand larceny. In Week 10's lone blockbuster, CarlaCote shipped Matthew Golden to PrayingGrantis and walked away with both Nico Collins and Blake Corum. Even for a superteam architect like PrayingGrantis (7-3, league-high 1,532.72 PF), punting a certified alpha wideout like Collins plus Corum for Golden feels like accidentally hitting 'accept' between classes at Swan Hall.

Meanwhile, the ghost of ELord11's trade addiction continues to haunt the bottom of the standings. After wheeling and dealing across Weeks 7 and 9—shipping out Puka Nacua, Josh Jacobs, Jaylen Waddle, Kyren Williams, Omarion Hampton, and Tyler Warren to bring in Drake London, Garrett Wilson, A.J. Brown, Trey McBride, and Emeka Egbuka—ELord11 has assembled an all-star roster on paper that is somehow riding a five-game losing streak at 3-7. If there is a Rhody Hall of Fame for buying high and losing anyway, ELord11 already has a statue outside the Ryan Center.

roasts.headline: 10-0 Caaaam vs. Red-Hot CarlaCote Highlights Week 11 Slate After 0.42-Point Chaos
roasts.body:
Everybody in Narragansett is circling Caaaam vs. CarlaCote this week. Caaaam enters Week 11 at a pristine 10-0 with 1,510.16 points scored, a league-best 1,225.56 points against, and zero dollars of FAAB left—having blown half the budget on a defense in Week 1 and still coasted to perfection. Across the aisle sits CarlaCote (6-4, 2W streak), who just dropped 167.26 points on ELord11 last week and now gets to plug Nico Collins into a lineup built on $7 total FAAB spent all season. If anyone can hand Caaaam their first L, it's the manager who barely speaks in group chat and keeps sneaking out of the shadows with 160-bombs.

Elsewhere on the Week 11 slate, 7-3 Tylero0 gets a prime bounce-back spot against 2-8 owenriddell (riding a miserable 7-game losing streak and fresh off an 86.52-point dud). Tylero0 is still nursing whiplash after losing 152.56 to 152.14 against Shipoopiehole in Week 10—a 0.42-point nightmare that probably ruined their Sunday night at the Mews Tavern. Meanwhile, Shipoopiehole tries to make it two straight upsets against a reeling JewsInParis (7-3, 2L), while Unanswered (5-5) fights for playoff survival against juggernaut PrayingGrantis.

roasts.headline: JewsInParis Pays $8 for the Bills D, Caaaam Dumps McLaurin, and CerealStroke Still Refuses to Spend a Dime
roasts.body:
The Week 10/11 waiver wire looked less like strategic roster building and more like a yard sale outside Butterfield Dining Hall. JewsInParis, reeling from back-to-back losses and forever haunted by trading Drake London for Jordan Mason earlier in the lore, dropped $8 FAAB on the Buffalo Bills defense while cutting Devin Singletary, then followed it up Wednesday by ditching Jordan Addison for Elic Ayomanor. Tylero0 wasn't far behind, tossing $4 apiece at Mark Andrews, Kaelon Black, and the Pittsburgh Steelers defense while jettisoning Juwan Johnson, Tyler Higbee, and Keon Coleman.

Then there's the high-end roster carnage: Caaaam casually dropped Terry McLaurin and Jason Sanders into the free-agent pool like loose change, PrayingGrantis spent $7 on Xavier Hutchinson and grabbed Kirk Cousins, and Shipoopiehole burned $5 on Seth McGowan and scooped Pat Bryant. And let's give a sarcastic round of applause to CerealStroke—1-9, still sitting on $100 of untouched FAAB ($0 used all year), yet somehow bothering to make a $0 free-agent swap of Geno Smith for Justice Hill right before dropping 164.18 points on owenriddell. At least they remembered waivers exist.

roasts.headline: Three-Way Logjam at 7-3 Behind Caaaam While Unanswered Clings to the .500 Bubble
roasts.body:
With four weeks left before the fantasy postseason, the Rhody standings have split into three distinct neighborhoods. Caaaam (10-0) sits alone in the penthouse, practically guaranteed a first-round bye despite leaving 210.6 bench points on the table. Right below sits a ferocious 7-3 traffic jam: PrayingGrantis (1,532.72 PF, 2W), Tylero0 (1,475.48 PF, 1L), and JewsInParis (1,450.16 PF, 2L). PrayingGrantis actually leads the entire league in scoring—while also burning a league-worst 232.22 bench points—meaning their ceiling is terrifying once lineups are set.

The real stress lives in the middle: CarlaCote (6-4) is surging at the exact right time, while Unanswered (5-5, 1,294.50 PF, $0 FAAB remaining) is staring straight at a must-win matchup against PrayingGrantis to stay afloat. Down in the basement, ELord11 (3-7, 5L) needs a miracle, Shipoopiehole (2-8, league-worst 1,508.60 PA) has been brutally schedule-fucked all year, owenriddell (2-8, 7L) is in total freefall, and CerealStroke (1-9, 1,056.80 PF) is just playing spoiler with house money.

powerRankings.blurb: Ten weeks, ten wins, 1,510.16 points scored, and a feather-soft 1,225.56 points against—the newsletter author is cruising through Rhody like it's an intramural flag football league. Even with $0 FAAB left and Terry McLaurin tossed into the dumpster, nobody can touch the throne until CarlaCote proves otherwise.

A league-leading 1,532.72 points and a massive 176.14-point Week 10 beatdown of JewsInParis confirm this superteam is still the scariest roster in Kingston. The only reason the panic meter isn't zero is gifting Nico Collins and Blake Corum to CarlaCote for Matthew Golden while leaving 232.22 points rotting on the bench.

Sitting at 7-3 with 1,475.48 points, Tylero0 owns a legitimate contender after turning Drake London and Garrett Wilson into Puka Nacua. Still, losing by 0.42 points to 2-win Shipoopiehole stings badly, and burning $12 FAAB on Mark Andrews, Kaelon Black, and the Steelers D screams slight Tuesday-night tilt.

Witness protection looks good on 6-4 CarlaCote, who just erupted for 167.26 points, rides a two-game win streak, and somehow spent only $7 FAAB all season. Swindling Nico Collins and Blake Corum out of PrayingGrantis makes them a legitimate threat to ruin Caaaam's undefeated dream this week.

The 7-3 record looks shiny until you notice the two-game losing streak, a porous 1,414.74 points against, and last week's 39-point humiliation against PrayingGrantis. Dropping Jordan Addison for Elic Ayomanor and blowing $8 on the Bills D suggests the post-Jordan Mason hangover is creeping back in.

Dead even at 5-5 with 1,294.50 points scored and zero FAAB left in the vault, Unanswered is living on the razor's edge after getting dusted 158.32 - 123.66 by Caaaam. Acquiring Josh Jacobs and Jaylen Waddle from ELord11 helps, but drawing PrayingGrantis in Week 11 could push this squad below .500.

Five straight losses have sunk the league's most compulsive trader to 3-7 despite 1,289.30 respectable points and a star-studded receiver room of Drake London, Garrett Wilson, and A.J. Brown. At some point you have to stop hitting the trade button at 2:13 AM and actually win a Sunday.

At 2-8 with a horrifying 1,508.60 points against, Shipoopiehole has absorbed more bad luck than anyone in Rhode Island—until Week 10's glorious 152.56 - 152.14 upset over Tylero0. Scooping Seth McGowan for $5 and Pat Bryant for free shows this spoiler isn't going quietly.

Finally off the schneid at 1-9 after nuking owenriddell for 164.18 points, CerealStroke deserves a golf clap for at least adding Justice Hill for $0. Still, owning a league-worst 1,056.80 points, 214.44 bench points, and $100 of untouched FAAB in mid-November keeps them firmly in the cellar.

Seven straight losses, 1,155.18 points scored, and getting doubled up 86.52 to 164.18 by the previously winless CerealStroke is pure fantasy rock bottom. Dropping Konata Mumpfield while sitting on $77 unused FAAB isn't going to fix a season that's already drifted out into Point Judith Pond.

tradeGrades.summary: CarlaCote received Nico Collins (WR - HOU) & Blake Corum (RB - LAR); PrayingGrantis received Matthew Golden (WR - GB)
tradeGrades.verdict: CarlaCote wakes up from witness protection and pulls off a straight-up heist, landing a WR1 in Nico Collins plus RB depth in Blake Corum for Matthew Golden alone. PrayingGrantis can afford a luxury gamble at 7-3, but this is brutal value.

tradeGrades.summary: Tylero0 received Puka Nacua (WR - LAR); ELord11 received Drake London (WR - ATL) & Garrett Wilson (WR - NYJ)
tradeGrades.verdict: A surprisingly fair blockbuster where Tylero0 consolidates into a weekly difference-maker in Puka Nacua, while ELord11 gets two high-volume wideouts to try to stop the bleeding. Unfortunately for ELord11, it hasn't snapped the five-game skid yet.

tradeGrades.summary: Unanswered received Josh Jacobs (RB - GB) & Jaylen Waddle (WR - DEN); ELord11 received A.J. Brown (WR - NE)
tradeGrades.verdict: Unanswered smartly turns A.J. Brown into two playable starters in Josh Jacobs and Jaylen Waddle to keep their 5-5 playoff hopes alive. ELord11 gets the flashier name, which seems to be their favorite hobby regardless of the standings.

tradeGrades.summary: ELord11 received Trey McBride (TE - ARI) & Emeka Egbuka (WR - TB); owenriddell received Kyren Williams (RB - LAR), Omarion Hampton (RB - LAC) & Tyler Warren (TE - IND)
tradeGrades.verdict: On paper, ELord11 grabbed elite tight-end production in Trey McBride and WR upside in Emeka Egbuka while owenriddell loaded up on running back depth with Kyren Williams and Omarion Hampton. In reality, both managers are buried at 3-7 and 2-8 on massive losing streaks, proving neither roster was saved.
